title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on Amending the Reply of the Supreme People's Court on the Issue of What Standard Shall Be Applied for Calculating Liquidated Damages for Overdue Payment

articles.content_en:
Fa Shi [2000] No. 34

Higher People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; and the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the Higher People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

Some courts have reported that certain contents of our Court's Fa Shi [1999] No. 8 Reply on the Issue of the Standard for Calculating Liquidated Damages for Overdue Payment are inconsistent with the People's Bank of China Announcement on Reducing Interest Rates on Deposits and Loans of Financial Institutions. Upon study, this Reply is as follows:

The content in the Supreme People's Court Fa Shi [1999] No. 8 Reply stating "in accordance with the provisions of the People's Bank of China's Yin Fa [1996] No. 156 Notice on Reducing Interest Rates on Deposits and Loans of Financial Institutions issued on April 30, 1996, the current standard for liquidated damages for overdue payment may be calculated at 0.04% per day" shall be deleted.

This Reply is hereby given.
